test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 03 Dec 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
A # B means 'A is the mother of B'.

A @ B means 'A is the son of B'.

A & B means 'A is the brother of B'.

A % B means 'A is the wife of B'.

If W # Q @ T & Y @ M % K, then how is K related to W?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/94f0af2bd93b93688d2c6092e652fb2d84f74342de195154154b4e73abc5a0da.png] 

Given :

 
 

 
 
A is

 
 
 

 
 
Symbol

 
 
 
#

 
 
 
@

 
 
 
&

 
 %

to B

 
 
 

Statement given : **W # Q @ T & Y @ M % K**

So,

 
• W # Q → W is the mother of Q.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f91b1bae65aa040d26b9c1c2b8be547b61b35c3ef44b1ccb2294617949441a40.png] 

 
• Q @ T → Q is the son of T.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e0d7f636c1d71c785ab7f5192ed53e49d75931ee619d25b91b9687f7ea2ec542.png] 

 
• T & Y → T is the brother of Y.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c5e0146487cd476be293a1e028e69a02f101907e725ea3044217c55ee7a79fe4.png] 

 
• Y @ M → Y is the son of M.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a0ec5cbd8acef24fc0e3b6bf67e3badbb8d3b7d1a377dd03fa96f89395a9ea9.png] 

 
• M % K → M is the wife of K.

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9ebb03c29c62af3bb0c5c882f77548a2631af1baae0b29c5c6477f74408fc982.png] 

Thus, according to the final family tree K is the father-in-law of W.

Hence, "**Father-in-law**" is the correct answer.
